title: Ukraine Expands Drone Warfare to North Africa
subtitle: A recent attack on a Russian warship in Libya shows the conflict is spreading far beyond the borders of Eastern Europe.

summary.en: Ukraine recently used explosive naval drones to sink a Russian warship in the Libyan port of Benghazi. The attack also damaged a cargo ship that was reportedly carrying weapons. This operation shows that the war between Russia and Ukraine is now reaching far beyond the main battlefields. Experts note that the Russian ship was unable to enter the Black Sea due to international rules. Libyan officials reported that at least ten people were killed in the incident.
summary.zh: 烏克蘭近期利用自殺式無人艇，在利比亞的班加西港擊沉了一艘俄羅斯軍艦。此次攻擊同時損毀了一艘據稱載有武器的貨船。這項行動顯示俄烏戰爭的影響範圍已遠超主要戰場。專家指出，由於國際法規限制，該俄國軍艦無法進入黑海。利比亞官員表示，這起事件造成至少十人死亡。

paragraphs.en: The war between Russia and Ukraine has reached a new and unexpected location. On November 22, Ukrainian forces used explosive naval drones to sink a Russian warship in the port city of Benghazi, Libya. This bold operation also hit a Russian cargo ship that was traveling with the warship. The event shows that the conflict is no longer limited to the front lines in Ukraine, but is now expanding across the Mediterranean Sea.
paragraphs.zh: 俄羅斯與烏克蘭之間的戰爭已蔓延至一個出人意料的新地點。11月22日，烏克蘭部隊利用自殺式無人艇，在利比亞的班加西港擊沉了一艘俄羅斯軍艦。這場大膽的行動同時擊中了一艘隨行的俄羅斯貨船。此事件顯示，衝突已不再侷限於烏克蘭境內的前線，而是正擴展至地中海地區。

paragraphs.en: According to Ars Technica, the Russian missile corvette Merkury sank at the port after being hit by at least two naval drones. Ukraine’s Security Service stated that they used seven drones launched from a mother ship to complete the mission. President Volodymyr Zelenskyy later shared video footage of the attack. The video showed the small, fast drone boats moving toward the ships and exploding on impact. The attack destroyed the warship and also damaged a cargo ship named the MV Angara. President Zelenskyy claimed that the MV Angara was being used to transport weapons to the Libyan National Army, a group that controls Benghazi and is fighting against the internationally recognized government in Tripoli.
paragraphs.zh: 根據科技媒體 Ars Technica 報導，俄羅斯飛彈護衛艦「水星號」（Merkury）在遭到至少兩艘無人艇攻擊後沉沒於港口。烏克蘭國家安全局表示，他們動用了七艘從母船發射的無人艇來執行這項任務。烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基隨後分享了攻擊的影像紀錄。影片顯示，這些小型且快速的無人艇朝目標船隻駛去，並在撞擊時引爆。此次攻擊摧毀了該軍艦，並重創了一艘名為「安加拉號」（MV Angara）的貨船。澤倫斯基聲稱，安加拉號當時正被用於運送武器給「利比亞國民軍」（Libyan National Army），這是一個控制班加西並與位於的黎波里的國際承認政府對抗的武裝組織。

paragraphs.en: This attack has caused significant loss of life. Officials from the Libyan National Army told The Associated Press that at least 10 people were killed, including both Libyan and Russian citizens. Other crew members who were hurt during the explosions were moved to local hospitals for medical care. The Merkury was a powerful ship, equipped with missiles for air defense and anti-ship combat, as well as torpedoes to fight against submarines. It also carried a Ka-27 combat helicopter, which was destroyed during the strike.
paragraphs.zh: 這場攻擊造成了嚴重的人員傷亡。利比亞國民軍官員向美聯社表示，至少有10人喪生，其中包括利比亞與俄羅斯公民。其他在爆炸中受傷的船員已被送往當地醫院接受治療。水星號是一艘戰力強大的艦艇，配備了用於防空與反艦作戰的飛彈，以及對抗潛艦的魚雷。該艦還搭載了一架卡-27（Ka-27）戰鬥直升機，也在這次打擊中被摧毀。

paragraphs.en: There is a specific reason why this Russian ship was in Libya rather than in the Black Sea, where most of Russia’s fleet is based. After Russia launched its full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022, Turkey used the 1936 Montreux Convention to close the Turkish Straits. This international agreement allows Turkey to restrict warships from entering or leaving the Black Sea during times of war. Because of this, the Merkury could not join the Black Sea fleet. Instead, naval analyst HI Sutton noted that the ship had been operating from bases in the Arctic.
paragraphs.zh: 這艘俄羅斯軍艦之所以出現在利比亞而非俄國艦隊主力所在的黑海，是有特定原因的。自俄羅斯於2022年對烏克蘭發動全面入侵後，土耳其引用1936年的《蒙特勒公約》（Montreux Convention）封鎖了土耳其海峽。這項國際協議允許土耳其在戰爭期間限制軍艦進出黑海。因此，水星號無法加入黑海艦隊。海軍分析師薩頓（HI Sutton）指出，該艦此前一直從北極地區的基地執行任務。

paragraphs.en: This incident is part of a larger trend of Ukraine using long-range technology to challenge Russian forces far from home. Recent reports indicate that Ukraine has been increasing its use of naval drones to target Russian vessels from the coast of North Africa all the way to the Gulf of Finland. By striking ships in Libya, Ukraine is showing that it can reach Russian military assets in distant waters. This strategy puts new pressure on the Russian Navy, which must now worry about its safety even in ports far away from the main war zone.
paragraphs.zh: 此事件是烏克蘭利用長程科技挑戰遠方俄軍這一趨勢的一部分。近期報告顯示，烏克蘭正增加使用無人艇的頻率，目標鎖定從北非海岸一直到芬蘭灣的俄羅斯船隻。透過打擊利比亞境內的船隻，烏克蘭展現了其有能力觸及遠方海域的俄軍資產。此策略對俄羅斯海軍造成了新的壓力，他們現在必須擔憂即便是在遠離主要戰區的港口，其安全性也無法獲得保障。

paragraphs.en: For the people of Libya, this attack is a worrying sign that the local conflict is becoming more dangerous. The Russian military has been providing material support to the Libyan National Army for some time. By targeting these supply lines, Ukraine is directly interfering with Russia’s ability to support its allies in North Africa. This adds a new layer of complexity to the already difficult situation in Libya, where two different groups are fighting for control of the country.
paragraphs.zh: 對利比亞人民而言，這場攻擊是一個令人擔憂的信號，顯示當地衝突正變得更加危險。俄羅斯軍方長期以來一直為利比亞國民軍提供物資支援。烏克蘭透過鎖定這些補給線，直接干擾了俄羅斯支援其北非盟友的能力。這為利比亞本已艱困的局勢增添了新的複雜性，該國目前正由兩個不同的陣營爭奪控制權。

paragraphs.en: As the situation develops, it remains unclear how Russia will respond to this loss. The sinking of the Merkury is a major blow to the Russian Navy, both in terms of military hardware and prestige. Military analysts are watching closely to see if Russia will increase security for its ships in foreign ports or if it will take other actions to prevent future attacks. For now, the successful strike in Benghazi marks a significant change in how the war is being fought, proving that modern drone technology can turn almost any body of water into a battlefield.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著局勢發展，俄羅斯將如何回應此次損失尚不明朗。水星號的沉沒對俄羅斯海軍而言，無論是在軍事硬體還是聲望上都是重大打擊。軍事分析家正密切關注俄羅斯是否會加強其在海外港口船隻的維安，或是採取其他行動以防止未來再次遇襲。就目前而言，班加西的成功打擊標誌著戰爭型態的重大轉變，證明現代無人機科技幾乎能將任何水域變成戰場。

keyTerms.definitionEn: A military attack, often involving an air or naval raid.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（打擊），這裡作名詞用。文中：It also carried a Ka-27 combat helicopter, which was destroyed during the strike.

keyTerms.definitionEn: Useful or valuable things, in this case, military equipment or resources.
keyTerms.definitionZh: 資產；這裡指軍事裝備或資源。
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見於金融領域，這裡指軍事上的戰力資源。文中：By striking ships in Libya, Ukraine is showing that it can reach Russian military assets in distant waters.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A sudden event that causes damage, disappointment, or failure.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作動詞（吹氣），這裡作名詞指嚴重的挫折。文中：The sinking of the Merkury is a major blow to the Russian Navy, both in terms of military hardware and prestige.

previousArticles.title: Russian Warship Sinks in Libya After Suspected Drone Attack
previousArticles.summaryEn: A Russian navy ship, the Merkury, sank in the Libyan port of Benghazi following a suspected drone attack on Sunday. Libyan officials reported that the vessel was refueling when it was struck, causing a large explosion. While no group has officially claimed responsibility, experts suggest Ukraine is the likely actor behind the strike. The attack has raised serious concerns about the safety of Libyan ports and the potential for international conflicts to reach North Africa. Authorities in eastern Libya have condemned the incident as a violation of their national sovereignty.

quiz.question: What specific equipment was lost alongside the Russian warship Merkury during the attack in Benghazi?

options.A: A fleet of seven naval drones used for the mission.
options.B: A Ka-27 combat helicopter stored on the ship.
options.C: A shipment of weapons intended for the Libyan National Army.
options.D: A collection of torpedoes designed for anti-submarine warfare.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第三段結尾，明確提到 Merkury 號不僅是一艘強大的軍艦，還搭載了一架 Ka-27 戰鬥直升機，該直升機在襲擊中被摧毀。選項 A 錯誤，因為七架無人機是烏克蘭發射的攻擊工具，而非隨艦設備；選項 C 雖然提到武器運輸，但那是 MV Angara 貨船的任務，而非 Merkury 號本身的設備；選項 D 雖然提到該艦配備魚雷，但文章僅提到魚雷是其配備，並未說明魚雷在這次攻擊中被視為主要的「損失」項目，直升機才是明確被點出摧毀的資產。

quiz.question: Why was the Merkury stationed in Libya instead of serving in the Black Sea?

options.A: It was specifically assigned to protect Russian interests in North Africa.
options.B: The ship was too damaged from previous Arctic missions to return to the Black Sea.
options.C: International maritime regulations prevented the ship from entering the Black Sea.
options.D: The Russian Navy preferred to keep its most advanced warships away from the front lines.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據第四段，由於俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭，土耳其引用 1936 年《蒙特勒公約》（Montreux Convention）關閉了土耳其海峽，限制軍艦在戰時進出黑海。因此，Merkury 號無法進入黑海艦隊，被迫在其他地區（如北極）作業。選項 A 是推論錯誤，文章未顯示其主要任務是保護北非；選項 B 與文章內容矛盾，文中並未提到該艦有舊傷；選項 D 為過度解讀，文章明確指出是法律限制導致其無法部署於黑海，而非戰術選擇。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, the author states that the sinking of the Merkury is a major blow to the Russian Navy's 'prestige.' What does 'prestige' mean in this context?

options.A: The physical strength and defensive capabilities of a naval fleet.
options.B: The respect, status, or reputation held by an organization.
options.C: The financial budget allocated for military hardware maintenance.
options.D: The strategic advantage gained by controlling specific maritime routes.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。在文中，「prestige」指的是俄羅斯海軍在國際間的聲望與地位。當一艘強大的軍艦被無人機擊沉，這不僅是硬體損失（military hardware），更會損害俄羅斯海軍的威信與形象。選項 A 混淆了硬體實力；選項 C 與財務預算無關；選項 D 雖然軍事上重要，但「prestige」一詞的核心意義在於名聲與尊嚴，而非戰略優勢。因此 B 是最精確的解釋。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding the current state of the Russia-Ukraine war?

options.A: The conflict in Libya is becoming the most important battleground for both nations.
options.B: Russia is successfully using its navy to block Ukrainian supply lines in North Africa.
options.C: Technological advancements have made it impossible for warships to defend themselves.
options.D: The war has expanded globally, as Ukraine now uses drone technology to target Russian assets far from the front lines.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章的主旨在於探討戰爭形式的轉變，即烏克蘭利用長程無人機技術，將戰火從烏克蘭本土擴展至北非等地，對俄羅斯海軍造成全球性的安全壓力。選項 A 誇大了利比亞戰場的重要性；選項 B 與事實相反，是烏克蘭在打擊俄羅斯的補給線；選項 C 過於絕對，文章雖提到無人機的威脅，但並未宣稱軍艦已完全無法防禦。因此 D 最能概括全文的核心論點。
